sections.content: You know the future from A2 Unit 19, *ir a* + infinitive from A1 Unit 25 and *es posible que* + subjunctive from B1 Unit 13. Here you use them with *probablemente* and *es probable que* to show how sure a prediction is: the future for what you expect, *es probable que* + subjunctive for what is likely.

items.spanish: Es probable que la situación cambie.
items.english: It is likely that the situation will change.

items.spanish: Probablemente habrá nuevas formas de trabajar.
items.english: There will probably be new ways of working.

items.spanish: En el futuro, muchas personas van a trabajar de otra manera.
items.english: In the future, many people are going to work differently.

sections.content: A prediction can be presented as certain, likely or possible. Choose the structure that matches your level of certainty.
